settings.title: Settings
settings.continueButtonNote: Your last chat at the bottom of the home screen. Swipe it left to hide it until you next open a chat.
settings.baseUrlHint: Your Tailscale or local network address. No need to add the /v1 path.
settings.apiKeyHint: LM Studio, llama.cpp and Ollama usually don't check the key.
settings.backupNote: The JSON file contains characters, chats and avatars. The API key is not included. You can save it to Files or iCloud Drive.
settings.dangerNote: Erases all characters, chats, avatars and the server address. Cannot be undone.
settings.wipeConfirmMessage: All characters, chats, avatars and the server address will be deleted permanently.
about.tagline: A private roleplay chat with characters, talking to your own model.
about.dataText: Characters, chats and avatars are stored only on this device, in a local SQLite database.
about.serverText: Reverie doesn't send anything to third-party services — only to the address set in settings.
about.backupsText: Export and import save chats to a JSON file that stays with you.
about.shakeHint: Shake your phone to go through onboarding again.
characters.title: Characters
characters.deleteConfirmMessage: {{name}} and all chats with this character will be deleted permanently.
characters.serverNotSetText: Set the server address in settings so characters can reply.
characters.emptyText: Create your first character and start a story.
characters.wideWelcomeText: Pick a character on the left, or add a new one to start a story.
onboarding.slide1.title: Your own characters
onboarding.slide1.text: Set a name, personality and way of speaking — and start a conversation from a blank page.
onboarding.slide2.title: Full control
onboarding.slide2.text: Temperature, top-P, reply length — every character has its own generation settings.
onboarding.slide3.title: Your own model
onboarding.slide3.text: Reverie talks to a server on your network — LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp. Nothing leaves it.
onboarding.slide4.title: It all stays with you
onboarding.slide4.text: Chats and avatars are stored only on this device, in a local database.
editor.thinkingHint: "Same as server" adds nothing to the request — the model thinks or not according to what's set up in LM Studio. "On" and "Off" override this for this character if the loaded model lets thinking be switched (LM Studio lists this per model).
editor.replyLengthHint: The model gets an instruction to keep within this number of paragraphs. With no limit, the system prompt stays untouched.
editor.greetingHint: The first message the character sends in a new chat.
editor.greetingPlaceholder: *looks up from the fire* Come in, traveler.
editor.systemPromptHint: Personality, role, speech style and setting.
editor.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are Eliara, a wandering herbalist...
promptGen.title: AI generator
promptGen.hint: Who they are, their temperament, the setting, how they treat the user. A couple of sentences is enough: the AI fills in the details.
promptGen.placeholder: A cynical starship mechanic who hides a soft heart and speaks in short, dry sentences...
promptGen.empty: The model returned an empty response. Try again or rephrase the description.
promptGen.changesPlaceholder: E.g. make him grumpier, add a fear of heights. You can leave this empty.
promptGen.improveHint: With no requests the AI just polishes the prompt: fills gaps, removes contradictions and makes the character more vivid.
promptGen.idea1.title: Herbalist
promptGen.idea1: A wandering herbalist from a northern village, calm and observant, speaks in proverbs and distrusts city folk
promptGen.idea2.title: Noir detective
promptGen.idea2: A tired private eye from a rainy 1940s city, cynical and vivid in speech, but always sides with the underdog
promptGen.idea3.title: Ship AI
promptGen.idea3: The onboard AI of a long-haul cargo ship, polite to the point of pedantry, secretly missing the crew who have been in cryosleep for years
promptGen.idea4.title: Language tutor
promptGen.idea4: A friendly Spanish tutor who gently corrects mistakes, explains with examples from movies and loves a good joke
promptGen.withGreetingHint: The character's first message in a new chat.
promptGen.withGreetingReplace: The character's first message. The current greeting will be replaced.
promptGen.revisePlaceholder: What should change in this version?
promptGen.tweakShorter.note: make the prompt noticeably shorter, keeping what matters most
promptGen.tweakLonger.note: add more detail: background, habits, concrete traits
promptGen.tweakSpeech.note: add a few characteristic sample lines of the character's speech
promptGen.tweakVivid.note: make the character bolder and more unusual, drop generic traits
editor.deleteConfirmMessage: The character and all chats with it will be deleted permanently.
chat.refineMessage: How should the reply be rewritten? For example: "more surprised", "sadder", "shorter and less descriptive".
chat.deleteChatMessage: The chat will be deleted permanently.
chat.renameChatMessage: Leave the field empty to remove the name.
chat.titleNotFoundTitle: Couldn't come up with a title
chat.titleNotFoundMessage: The model returned an empty response. Try again.
chat.titleFailedTitle: Couldn't come up with a title
chat.privateHint: No character, no history. Tap the eye again and this conversation is gone.
chat.emptyReply: The model returned an empty response
chatsList.emptyText: A character is a template: you can have as many separate stories with it as you like.
textSheet.title: Select text
startup.webSingleTab: The database is only available to one tab. Close the other Reverie tabs and reload the page.
llm.corsHint: . If the server is running, enable CORS on it: the browser blocks the request without it
llm.timeout: The server didn't respond within 8 seconds. Check the address and network.
llm.baseUrlMissing: No server address set. Open settings and enter one.
images.cameraPermission: No camera access. You can enable it in iOS settings.
avatarStore.noSpace: The browser's storage has no room left for another avatar.
backup.corrupted: The file is corrupted or is not a Reverie backup.
backup.notBackup: This is not a Reverie backup.
